steps.caption: Open Settings at the bottom of the sidebar, then the AI use tab.
The summary: how many features use AI, how many run on code only, and how many AI calls were avoided this month.
Off = code only. Backup = code first, AI only when code can't read the input. On = AI first, code if AI fails. Nothing is lost when a feature is Off.
Runs on code: rules and templates do these well — morning brief, daily plan, score explanations, outreach drafts and more. AI is off by default.
Each feature says what it does and whether it is on its default.
Code first, AI as backup: capture fields, lease terms, quotes, legal clauses and reading text from photos. Code tries first.
Needs AI: voice transcription, web research, signal discovery and open writing — code can't do these well.
Each switch has three positions. Off, Backup or On — hover a position to see what it means.
A changed feature says so, with its default. Here 'Reading text from images & scans' is set to Off — code only.
To change a switch: pick the position, then press Save at the bottom. Reset to defaults puts every feature back (you confirm first).
For the workspace owner, saving needs two-step sign-in first. The note links to Settings → Security, where you turn it on.
Open Security & MFA to see the two-step sign-in set-up.
After setting it up, come back to AI use: the switches can be changed and saved. When a feature is Off, CRE OS makes no AI call at all.
